neighbours.label: ' some'/' long' in a duration phrase predicting 'time' ('for some time', 'a long time ago')
fire: Doctors have suspected for some time that the virus affects the heart.
That old bridge should have been repaired a long time ago.
The two companies have been talking about a merger for some time now.
He had stopped feeling the cold some time before the rescuers arrived.
They wrote about this prophecy a long time ago in the ancient scrolls.
Experts have warned for some time that the dam could fail.
We have known each other for a long time, since primary school.
It seems the drought will stay with us for some time yet.
quiet: Doctors have suspected that some patients react badly to the vaccine.
That old bridge should have been repaired with some steel beams.
The two companies have been talking about some new products lately.
He had stopped feeling the cold in some parts of his feet.
They wrote about this prophecy on a long scroll in the ancient temple.
Experts have warned that some parts of the dam could fail.
We have walked together along a long road since primary school.
It seems the drought will stay with some farmers yet.
